title: arxmcp.bridge/verdict-record v1
description: A domain-tagged verdict over a statement. Verdict vocabularies are deliberately NOT unified across domains (SP2 measured exactly ["VERIFIED"] overlap across pipelines); each domain carries its own vocabulary, enforced below via if/then so a cross-domain enum leak is a schema violation. Domain vocabularies are append-only within this MAJOR. The cite-audit vocabulary is intentionally UNPINNED at v1.0 (no code-verified ground truth for its enum at authoring time); pinning it later is constraint-tightening and therefore lands as a MAJOR bump or before the first cite-audit producer ships (see CONTRACTS.md). Producer: lean_verify wrappers / panel agents / proving orchestrator. Consumer: articles, run ledger.

domain.description: Verdict domain. Append-only within this MAJOR. lean = raw lean_verify result status; proof-verify = the website panel/judge/final vocabulary; cite-audit = the citation-audit pipeline (vocabulary unpinned at v1.0); proving = the WS-D five-verdict taxonomy (D9).

statement_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact statement text the verdict is about.

statement.description: Optional inline copy of the statement text (LaTeX or Lean).

toolchain.description: Toolchain/environment pins for replayability (e.g. lean_toolchain, mathlib_rev, repl_transcript_sha256, model ids).
